description: This Java class 'EncounterTypeEditor' extends a property editor to serialize and deserialize 'EncounterType' objects, allowing them to be passed through web forms and retrieved via ID or UUID within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: EncounterTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing 'EncounterType' objects, supporting retrieval by ID and UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType object by its numeric ID using the EncounterService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType object by its UUID using the EncounterService.
